text:
Gold Price in 1968
Among 9 monthly observations available for 1968, the LBMA gold price rose 7.2% between 1968-04-30 ($39.10) and 1968-12-31 ($41.90). The highest sampled price was $41.95 in May and the lowest was $38.85 in July. The mean of these observations was $40.11. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
